item.title: Hawks vs Mavericks: Atlanta's Historic 10-Game Win Streak Faces Dallas Test
item.description: Hawks vs Mavericks is one of the most lopsided matchups on the NBA schedule this week, and the numbers tell a striking story. Atlanta has not lost a game in nearly three weeks, while Dallas cannot seem to find a win. When the Hawks visit American Airlines Center on Wednesday, March 18 at 8:30 PM EDT, they will be looking to extend a streak the franchise has not seen in over a decade.
